name: c1_shaft
prompt: View looking straight down from the broken floor of an abandoned hospital corridor into an impossibly deep square vertical shaft. Square floor tiles have fallen away leaving a square hole. Below, dozens of identical concrete floor levels recede to a single vanishing point, each level ringed by small dim emergency lamps, thick pipes and cable trays running down the walls, a steel maintenance ladder, the very bottom lost in pitch black. Extreme vertigo, huge depth. Photorealistic cinematic still, Unreal Engine quality, clean and dry surfaces, cold desaturated blue-green palette with a few warm dying lights, deep black shadows, thin dust haze, silent and oppressive. No people, no blood, no mold, no moss, no rust, no stains, no debris, no text, no signs.
